info.description: List remote source's inventory of VMs. The remote source is the onprem vCenter (remote in the sense it's not in Compute Engine). The inventory describes the list of existing VMs in that source. Note...
info.title: VM Migration API

requests.description: Upgrades the appliance relate to this DatacenterConnector to the in-place updateable version.
requests.name: POST /v1alpha1/{datacenterConnector}:upgradeAppliance
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Adds a MigratingVm to a Group.
requests.name: POST /v1alpha1/{group}:addGroupMigration
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes a MigratingVm from a Group.
requests.name: POST /v1alpha1/{group}:removeGroupMigration
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Marks a migration as completed, deleting migration resources that are no longer being used. Only applicable after cutover is done.
requests.name: POST /v1alpha1/{migratingVm}:finalizeMigration
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Pauses a migration for a VM. If cycle tasks are running they will be cancelled, preserving source task data. Further replication cycles will not be triggered while the VM is paused.
requests.name: POST /v1alpha1/{migratingVm}:pauseMigration
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Resumes a migration for a VM. When called on a paused migration, will start the process of uploading data and creating snapshots; when called on a completed cut-over migration, will update the migration to active state and start the process of uploading data and creating snapshots.
requests.name: POST /v1alpha1/{migratingVm}:resumeMigration
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Starts migration for a VM. Starts the process of uploading data and creating snapshots, in replication cycles scheduled by the policy.
requests.name: POST /v1alpha1/{migratingVm}:startMigration
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes a single TargetProject. NOTE: TargetProject is a global resource; hence the only supported value for location is `global`.
requests.name: DELETE /v1alpha1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets details of a single TargetProject. NOTE: TargetProject is a global resource; hence the only supported value for location is `global`.
requests.name: GET /v1alpha1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the parameters of a single TargetProject. NOTE: TargetProject is a global resource; hence the only supported value for location is `global`.
requests.name: PATCH /v1alpha1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists information about the supported locations for this service.
requests.name: GET /v1alpha1/{name}/locations
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists operations that match the specified filter in the request. If the server doesn't support this method, it returns `UNIMPLEMENTED`.
requests.name: GET /v1alpha1/{name}/operations
requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Initiates the cancellation of a running cutover job.

requests.note: Replace {{VM_MIGRATION_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
